ling_horizons.title: LING Horizons
ling_horizons.options.renderingEnabled.t: Enables or disables distant voxel LOD rendering.
ling_horizons.options.qualityScale.toolt: Controls the geometric detail and section subdivision of distant terrain.
ling_horizons.options.renderDistance.too: Maximum horizontal distance in chunks that LOD terrain will be rendered.
ling_horizons.options.earthCurveRatio.to: Simulates realistic spherical planet curvature for distant horizon terrain.
ling_horizons.options.enableWaterSSR.too: Enables screen-space reflections and specular highlights on distant water quads.
Number of parallel worker threads used during /ling pregen.
voxy.config.title: LING Horizons
voxy.config.general.enabled.tooltip: Master switch to fully enable or disable the LING Horizons distant LOD system.
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of background threads for LOD generation and meshing.
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Shares Sodium chunk builder threads for background LOD updates, reducing stutter when moving quickly.
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables automatic real-time conversion of visited world chunks into LOD voxel octrees.
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Enables or disables GPU-driven voxel LOD rendering.
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Maximum screen-space bounding size before subdividing into finer LOD voxels (Lower = higher detail).
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Maximum horizontal distance of LOD terrain in chunks.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Applies atmospheric biome and environmental fog to distant terrain.
voxy.config.general.render_fog.tooltip: Enables or disables standard distance fog blending.
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Shows LOD draw calls, meshlet counts, and VRAM memory usage in the F3 debug screen.
voxy.sodium.page.title: LING Horizons
voxy.sodium.option.enabled.tooltip: Master switch to enable or disable the LING Horizons LOD engine.
voxy.sodium.option.enable_rendering.tool: Enable rendering of LOD terrain. Disable to keep data ingestion running without visual output.
voxy.sodium.option.ingest_enabled.toolti: Enable automatic conversion of visited chunks into LOD data.
voxy.sodium.option.render_distance.toolt: How far LOD terrain renders in chunks (Example: 512 chunks).
voxy.sodium.option.service_threads.toolt: Number of background threads for LOD processing. More threads = faster LOD generation.
voxy.sodium.option.subdivision_size.tool: Maximum screen-space size before subdividing to higher detail LODs. Lower = more detail.
voxy.sodium.option.environmental_fog.too: Apply environmental and biome fog effects to LOD terrain.
voxy.sodium.option.dont_use_sodium_threa: Use an independent worker thread pool separate from Sodium chunk builder.
voxy.sodium.option.lod_boundary_buffer.t: Controls overlap between vanilla chunks and LODs. Higher = smoother transitions when flying fast.
voxy.sodium.option.render_statistics.too: Show LOD render statistics in the F3 debug screen.
voxy.sodium.option.earth_curve_ratio.too: Simulates standing on a spherical planet. 0 = Flat world. Higher values = smaller planet curvature effect.
VRAM allocated for LOD geometry storage. Auto scales safely (512MB-1GB) to prevent VRAM overflow.
Enables Screen-Space Reflections (SSR) and specular waves on distant oceans and lakes.
voxy.sodium.option.auto_pregen.tooltip: Automatically pre-generates LOD terrain in a radius upon joining a Singleplayer world.
voxy.sodium.option.auto_pregen_radius.to: Radius of chunks around world spawn to automatically pre-generate into LOD data (16 to 128 chunks).
voxy.sodium.option.auto_pregen_threads.t: Number of dedicated background worker threads for World Pre-generation (1 to 4 threads).
voxy.sodium.option.distant_shader_shadow: Enables shader cloud shadows, sunlight attenuation, and atmospheric lighting on distant LOD terrain via Iris.
